issue.title: Daily Stats snapshot kind: nightly lane sizes and walk-due-at-start
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-6l.6 (note #1); listed under "Later" in plan:202610/daily_stats.md and docs/stats.md.

Daily Stats derives every metric at read time from what the vault keeps, so point-in-time state the vault forgets cannot be charted: lane sizes (Pending, Next, Ready) at end of day and the ]s walk's due count at the start of the morning. Add a `snapshot` metric kind whose values `bob nightly` records once per day (append-only, per host, like the review journal under `.bob/stats/`), with readers in src/native/stats/ treating days before the first snapshot as not_tracked and gaps as missing (never zero). Needs: a storage contract in docs/stats.md, a vault .gitignore allowlist entry, nightly writer, engine kind + config params, golden fixture coverage, and Stats page panel choice.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a snapshot metric kind recorded once per day by bob nightly (lane sizes at end of day, ]s walk due at start) and charted by bob stats and the Stats page.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202610/daily_stats.md lists the snapshot kind under Later and Out of scope; v1 derives everything at read time.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-6l.6 proposed recording point-in-time state the vault forgets so Stats can chart lane sizes and walk due counts; the plan deferred it to Later.
